echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Straight up increases her Resonance Skill and Fusion DMG. Nightmare: Inferno Rider passively adds Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG with no echo-skill cast needed; use the normal Inferno Rider if you lack Rinascita access.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift + Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: More frequent Liberations thanks to the Energy Regen; useful against hordes of enemies and in boss fights.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; low — Energy Regen is 5th in her substat priorities (Liberation costs 140 energy)
build.fast_path: Fast path: The Last Dance (Static Mist if you lack the limited pistol) + 5-piece Molten Rift in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Inferno Rider in the main slot. Run CRIT DMG/Rate on the 4-cost, Fusion DMG on 3-costs, ATK% on 1-costs, and stack CRIT plus ATK% — her Liberation is a luxury, not the plan.

ranked_weapons.name: The Last Dance
ranked_weapons.note: Best-in-slot: high CRIT DMG stat plus 48% Resonance Skill DMG after Intro or Liberation. A limited weapon that ran alongside Carlotta, so Static Mist is the realistic premium pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% plus 20% All-Attribute DMG for the wielder when a teammate lands a Tune Break; strong in Tune Break teams.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: The longtime consensus best before The Last Dance: CRIT Rate and Energy Regen with an ATK buff for the incoming Resonator on Outro.

ranked_weapons.name: Thunderbolt
ranked_weapons.note: Best accessible option: stacks Resonance Skill DMG on Basic/Heavy hits, which Chixia does constantly.

ranked_weapons.name: Undying Flame
ranked_weapons.note: 20% Resonance Skill DMG after Intro Skill; solid 4-star alternative. Free last-resort: the 3-star Guardian Pistols.

stat_priorities.note: CRIT DMG preferred; at S1 her Resonance Skill always crits, so stack Crit DMG.

profile.role_note: Free hypercarry Fusion pistol DPS; straightforward and mobile, best at single-target damage. Her DAKA! DAKA! combo loop rewards precise positioning and resource management.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free launch-unit Fusion DPS who carries early accounts but falls off hard in the 3.7 meta — build her if she's your best option, never pull for her.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Chixia
members.note: On-field hypercarry; cycles DAKA! DAKA! combos and her Liberation under both buffs.

members.name: Changli
members.note: Second Fusion DPS; provides Fusion DMG amplification for Chixia.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and sustain; her Liberation field empowers both DPS units.

teams.name: Fusion Double DPS: Chixia + Changli + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with her Liberation and Outros into Changli, who builds Forte and bursts for Fusion amp. Chixia then takes the field with both buffs, cycling her combos and Liberation before rotating back.

members.name: Chixia
members.note: Takes an extended on-field window as the second Fusion DPS.

members.name: Encore
members.note: First Fusion DPS; spends Lupa's Pack Hunt and Glory buffs.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Premier Fusion Sub-DPS; activates Pack Hunt and Glory team-wide effects with her Liberation.

teams.name: Alternative: Mono Fusion with Lupa
teams.rotation: Lupa runs her rotation into Liberation to activate Pack Hunt and Glory, the first Fusion DPS spends the buffs, then Chixia takes an extended on-field window with DAKA! DAKA! before Outroing back to Lupa.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her Overall B as a Main DPS (A in Tower of Adversity this cycle); Beebom's 3.7 tier list places her in C — a solid early-game carry, outclassed in the current meta.

sequences.verdict: S0 is fully functional. S1 is the free power spike (always-crit Boom Boom); S6 completes her buffer role.

pull_path.why: Full DAKA DAKA! loop; copies arrive free from standard pulls.
Boom Boom always crits — the free power spike (destructoid, vgtimes).
Boom Boom grants the team +25% Basic Attack DMG for 15s.

nodes.name: Leaping Sparkles

nodes.effect: Liberation grants 60 Thermobaric Bullets and resets Whizzing Fight Spirit.

nodes.name: Triumphant Explosions
nodes.effect: At max Numbingly Spicy! stacks, +30% ATK additionally.

nodes.name: Easter Egg Performance
nodes.effect: Boom Boom grants all team members +25% Basic Attack DMG for 15s.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: No signature to chase — copies arrive free from standard pulls; S1 is the free power spike.
